The TAG Heuer Aquaracer Professional 200 Solargraph 40mm steel: WBP1110.BA0627 is the black dial version? Actually the Solargraph references:
- WBP1111.BA0627 — steel with black dial? 
- The Solargraph was introduced in 2022 as WBP1111.BA0627 (40mm, steel, black dial with rose gold accents? ) Hmm.

Known Solargraph references:
- WBP1110.BA0627: 40mm steel, blue dial? 
- WBP1111.BA0627: black/grey dial
- WBP1112.BA0627: ?
- Also titanium versions WBP1180.BF0000.

Common cited: TAG Heuer Aquaracer Professional 200 Solargraph 40mm WBP1111.BA0627 with black dial and rose gold accents? Actually I recall the Solargraph "WBP1110.BA0627" being the black dial with rose gold plated hands. Let me think further.

The original Solargraph (2022) was the "Solar Dial" with grey/black striped dial, steel bracelet, 40mm — reference WBP1110.BA0627. Yes, I believe WBP1110.BA0627 is the titanium? No, titanium Solargraph is WBP1180.BF0000 (40mm titanium, rubber strap?). Hmm.

TAG Heuer Aquaracer Professional 200 Solargraph:
- WBP1110.BA0627 — 40mm steel, black dial (Solargraph)
- WBP1111.BA0627 — 40mm steel, blue?
- WBP1112.BA0627 — green?
- WBP1180.BF0000 — titanium with... Actually the titanium Solargraph 40mm is WBP1180.BF0000? 

Also there's the 34mm Solargraph WBP1113... Hmm.

Also the "Solargraph" with the striped dial — I think the steel with black striped dial and rose gold hands is WBP1110.BA0627. I'll go with that, confidence moderate ~0.35.

Movement: solar (light-powered quartz). The category only allows automatic, manual, quartz, solar, hybrid, unknown — so "solar".
